## Overview Moves Kimi-K3's InferenceX AgentX lanes and its GB300 low-latency configuration into tuned **presets** (vllm-project/recipes [SCHEMA.md](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/SCHEMA.md) `presets`). The builder and the JSON API now render each lane's qualified points, builder choices and image; the guide previously told readers to adjust the command by hand. It also removes the DCP selector and DCP toggle: DCP lives only in the presets that qualified it. Follows #63520. ## Claims **Six presets.** | Preset | GPU · strategy | Default | Points | |---|---|---|---| | `gb200_agentx_agg` | GB200 · TP+PP | yes | C1–C56 (draft tokens, `--max-num-seqs`, CUDA graph sizes), Python frontend | | `gb200_agentx_pd` | GB200 · PD 1P1D | yes | C16/C32/C48; Dynamo, Rust frontend | | `gb300_agentx_pd` | GB300 · PD xPyD | yes | Dynamo, Rust frontend (worker counts stay in the runbook) | | `gb300_low_latency` | GB300 · multi-node TP | opt-in, **new** | C1 TP16/DCP16 on four trays, C2–C4 TP8/DCP8 on two | | `mi355x_agentx` | MI355X · TP | yes | every-concurrency settings, unchanged | | `mi355x_agentx_cells` | MI355X · TP | opt-in, **new** | the ten #4393 cells: DCP8, DSpark draft, resident/offload | **Removed:** the `decode_context_parallel` selector (GB200/GB300) and the `decode_context_parallelism` opt-in toggle. Kimi-K3 was their only user. - DCP isn't an independent choice here: only DCP equal to the lane's TP was qualified. - Picking Off on a preset silently dropped a qualified setting. - DCP pairs with an attention backend and env that a size selector can't carry. - The toggle's generic NVIDIA TP8/DCP8 form was never qualified by a lane. The Notes entry now lists the qualified DCP layouts and how DCP pairs. cc @hshrivastava-droid, who added the selector. **Guide:** the "Low latency serving" section becomes the `gb300_low_latency` preset's runbook. The lane runbooks drop their "select … in the builder" instructions and per-concurrency tables, which are now points and `select`. **Default renderings that change (intentionally):** three files, now the lane as it ran. Every other rendering is identical. | File | Change | |---|---| | `hw/gb200/strategies/multi_node_tp_pp.json` | adds the lane's `--compilation-config` (C32 graph sizes); Python frontend; lane image instead of `:latest` | | `hw/gb200/strategies/pd_cluster.json` | Dynamo: `dynamo.vllm` workers plus the Dynamo frontend; tool-call API flags dropped; lane image | | `hw/gb300/strategies/pd_cluster.json` | same as GB200 PD | ## Validation - `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir /recipes` passes against recipes main. - First commit (lanes moved into presets): all 71 Kimi-K3 renderings are identical to main. - After the second commit: - 67 of 71 renderings are identical. The four that differ are the three listed above plus the recipe JSON (the removed DCP field and toggle). - Six preset files are added (`/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/presets/*.json`). - Programmatic check of all 22 points against the lane sources (guide tables, the #4393 cell script and the low-latency script): - GB200 aggregated, 7 points: K, S, graph lists, TP8×PP2×DCP8 on four trays. - 1P1D, 3 points: per-role seqs, memory, graph caps; `dynamo.vllm`; Rust. - MI355X cells, 10 points: - seqs, batched tokens, compilation config (incl. `custom_ops`), draft and K; - the DCP8 pairing and env; - `--additional-config` / `--quantization-config`, offload bytes / `PYTHONHASHSEED`, image. - Low latency, 2 points: node count, TP=DCP, K, graph sizes, `latency_specialized`, env, one command per node. - Builder checks: - GB300 low latency switches between four and two trays, and a reload keeps the preset (with vllm-project/recipes#1177). - The MI355X cells turn KV offload on and off per cell. - GB200 / GB300 PD land on Dynamo. ## Details - **Opt-in vs default.** The three lanes that were already on for every GB200/GB300 user stay default, with the same per-point values; their remaining changes are the builder choices they ran with. The low-latency and MI355X cell configurations were guide-only, so they are opt-in. - **MI355X split.** The per-cell settings sit on a separate preset rather than as points of the default one. The every-concurrency default keeps the rolling image and no DCP, and the cells share their DCP8, draft and image at preset level instead of repeating them per point. - **Not in this PR:** - GB300 xPyD worker counts and the MI355X MoRIIO PD lane: several workers per PD role and the MoRIIO connector aren't builder features. - The Mooncake connector parameters of the GB200 lanes. - All three stay in the runbooks. ---

+      For tool calling and reasoning output, add `--reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-tool-call-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-enable-structural-tag` to both roles. `python3 -m dynamo.vllm` parses the remaining arguments as vLLM engine arguments only, so the vLLM API-server flags `--enable-auto-tool-choice` and `--tool-call-parser` are rejected there.
+
+      ### Specialized decode (low concurrency)
+
+      The c16-c32 points use the `latency_specialized` decode backend from [GB300 low-latency preset](#preset-gb300_low_latency) on the decode workers (1P3D for c16, 1P2D for c24-c32), with the Workers commands above changed as follows. The backend's requirements are listed there: V2 model runner (set in Environment), FULL decode CUDA graphs, BF16 convolution state with FP32 recurrent state, DSpark with at most 7 draft tokens, no pipeline or expert parallelism, and DCP of 1 or TP. The decode workers already meet the last two.
+
+      Both roles:
+
+      ```bash
+      --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32 --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1 --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune
+      # replacing --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 and --enable-flashinfer-autotune
+      ```
+
+      Pin `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1` on both roles. Left unset, NIXL P/D raises the DCP KV interleave to the KV block size after the specialized decode has read it, so its spec-verify causal mask uses the stale value.
+
+      Decode only:
+
+      ```bash
+      --additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}' \
+      --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true}' \
+      --max-num-seqs 12 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 64 \
+      --compilation-config "{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE\",\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\":[$(seq -s, 1 64)]}"
+      # replacing the regular decode's --attention-config (it also sets tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv),
+      # --max-num-seqs 128 and --max-cudagraph-capture-size 512
+      ```
+
+      `--max-num-seqs` is `64 // (K + 1)` with the K4 draft, so a full verify batch (12 x 5 = 60 tokens) fits the 64-token graph, and CUDA graphs are captured for every batch size up to 64. The prefill workers do not set `--additional-config`: the backend rejects the expert parallelism they use. The uncapped c48+ points keep the regular profile, so TTFT is not traded for ITL by a standing decode queue.
+
+      ### Frontend
+
+      ```bash
+      export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600 DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120
+      python3 -m dynamo.frontend --router-mode least-loaded --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 900
+      ```
+
+      Session affinity keeps each conversation on one worker so it reuses that worker's prefix cache; send the conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-Id` request header.
+
+  gb300_low_latency:
+    label: "Low latency"
+    hardware: gb300
+    strategy: multi_node_tp

## Overview Moves Kimi-K3's InferenceX AgentX lanes and its GB300 low-latency configuration into tuned **presets** (vllm-project/recipes [SCHEMA.md](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/SCHEMA.md) `presets`). The builder and the JSON API now render each lane's qualified points, builder choices and image; the guide previously told readers to adjust the command by hand. It also removes the DCP selector and DCP toggle: DCP lives only in the presets that qualified it. Follows #63520. ## Claims **Six presets.** | Preset | GPU · strategy | Default | Points | |---|---|---|---| | `gb200_agentx_agg` | GB200 · TP+PP | yes | C1–C56 (draft tokens, `--max-num-seqs`, CUDA graph sizes), Python frontend | | `gb200_agentx_pd` | GB200 · PD 1P1D | yes | C16/C32/C48; Dynamo, Rust frontend | | `gb300_agentx_pd` | GB300 · PD xPyD | yes | Dynamo, Rust frontend (worker counts stay in the runbook) | | `gb300_low_latency` | GB300 · multi-node TP | opt-in, **new** | C1 TP16/DCP16 on four trays, C2–C4 TP8/DCP8 on two | | `mi355x_agentx` | MI355X · TP | yes | every-concurrency settings, unchanged | | `mi355x_agentx_cells` | MI355X · TP | opt-in, **new** | the ten #4393 cells: DCP8, DSpark draft, resident/offload | **Removed:** the `decode_context_parallel` selector (GB200/GB300) and the `decode_context_parallelism` opt-in toggle. Kimi-K3 was their only user. - DCP isn't an independent choice here: only DCP equal to the lane's TP was qualified. - Picking Off on a preset silently dropped a qualified setting. - DCP pairs with an attention backend and env that a size selector can't carry. - The toggle's generic NVIDIA TP8/DCP8 form was never qualified by a lane. The Notes entry now lists the qualified DCP layouts and how DCP pairs. cc @hshrivastava-droid, who added the selector. **Guide:** the "Low latency serving" section becomes the `gb300_low_latency` preset's runbook. The lane runbooks drop their "select … in the builder" instructions and per-concurrency tables, which are now points and `select`. **Default renderings that change (intentionally):** three files, now the lane as it ran. Every other rendering is identical. | File | Change | |---|---| | `hw/gb200/strategies/multi_node_tp_pp.json` | adds the lane's `--compilation-config` (C32 graph sizes); Python frontend; lane image instead of `:latest` | | `hw/gb200/strategies/pd_cluster.json` | Dynamo: `dynamo.vllm` workers plus the Dynamo frontend; tool-call API flags dropped; lane image | | `hw/gb300/strategies/pd_cluster.json` | same as GB200 PD | ## Validation - `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir /recipes` passes against recipes main. - First commit (lanes moved into presets): all 71 Kimi-K3 renderings are identical to main. - After the second commit: - 67 of 71 renderings are identical. The four that differ are the three listed above plus the recipe JSON (the removed DCP field and toggle). - Six preset files are added (`/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/presets/*.json`). - Programmatic check of all 22 points against the lane sources (guide tables, the #4393 cell script and the low-latency script): - GB200 aggregated, 7 points: K, S, graph lists, TP8×PP2×DCP8 on four trays. - 1P1D, 3 points: per-role seqs, memory, graph caps; `dynamo.vllm`; Rust. - MI355X cells, 10 points: - seqs, batched tokens, compilation config (incl. `custom_ops`), draft and K; - the DCP8 pairing and env; - `--additional-config` / `--quantization-config`, offload bytes / `PYTHONHASHSEED`, image. - Low latency, 2 points: node count, TP=DCP, K, graph sizes, `latency_specialized`, env, one command per node. - Builder checks: - GB300 low latency switches between four and two trays, and a reload keeps the preset (with vllm-project/recipes#1177). - The MI355X cells turn KV offload on and off per cell. - GB200 / GB300 PD land on Dynamo. ## Details - **Opt-in vs default.** The three lanes that were already on for every GB200/GB300 user stay default, with the same per-point values; their remaining changes are the builder choices they ran with. The low-latency and MI355X cell configurations were guide-only, so they are opt-in. - **MI355X split.** The per-cell settings sit on a separate preset rather than as points of the default one. The every-concurrency default keeps the rolling image and no DCP, and the cells share their DCP8, draft and image at preset level instead of repeating them per point. - **Not in this PR:** - GB300 xPyD worker counts and the MI355X MoRIIO PD lane: several workers per PD role and the MoRIIO connector aren't builder features. - The Mooncake connector parameters of the GB200 lanes. - All three stay in the runbooks. ---

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restrict the low-latency preset to MXFP4**

When a user selects the existing `nvfp4` or `fp8` variant on GB300, this preset remains eligible because it has no `variants` qualifier, even though its runbook explicitly targets the default MXFP4 checkpoint. It then forces `decode_backend=latency_specialized`, whose expert kernel hard-codes MXFP4 scale geometry (`ExpertsGeometry.w13_scale_bytes` in `vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/specialized_decode/cutedsl/moe/experts.py:55-74`); applying that to the RedHat NVFP4/FP8 layouts can fail initialization or silently read incorrect expert scales. Add `variants: [default]` to this preset.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+      export VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS=4 MC_SLICE_SIZE=1048576 MC_MAX_MR_SIZE=4294967296 MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY=1
+      export VLLM_CONNECTOR_PREFETCH_DEPTH=8 VLLM_CONNECTOR_PREFETCH_KV_CAP=0.65
+      export UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE=n UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE=n UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED=1024 UCX_TCP_AF_PRIO=inet
+      export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120 ETCD_LEASE_TTL=600
+      export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800 VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT=600000
+      ```
+
+      Set `VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=1` on prefill workers and `VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=0` on decode workers. Loading the 2.8T checkpoint across trays and autotuning takes a while, which is why the engine-ready, execute-model and RPC timeouts are raised.
+
+      ### Workers
+
+      Each worker spans two trays. Run the command on both trays with the same `--master-addr` (the first tray's address), `--nnodes 2` and `--node-rank 0` or `1`.
+
+      Prefill:
+
+      ```bash
+      python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --served-model-name moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+        --disaggregation-mode prefill --request-plane tcp \
+        --nnodes 2 --node-rank <0|1> --master-addr <first-tray-ip> --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
+        --tensor-parallel-size 8 --decode-context-parallel-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \
+        --enable-expert-parallel --moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe \
+        --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA \
+        --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"trtllm_ragged_backend":"cute-dsl"}' \
+        --speculative-config '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
+        --enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 \
+        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --max-num-seqs 64 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 512 \
+        --enable-cumem-allocator --enable-flashinfer-autotune \
+        --load-format fastsafetensors --stream-interval 10 --language-model-only --trust-remote-code \
+        --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}' \
+        --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"compact_group_io":true,"max_load_batch_keys":2,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
+      ```
+
+      Decode (regular profile, `--max-num-seqs 128`):
+
+      ```bash
+      python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --served-model-name moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+        --disaggregation-mode decode --request-plane tcp \
+        --nnodes 2 --node-rank <0|1> --master-addr <first-tray-ip> --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
+        --tensor-parallel-size 8 --decode-context-parallel-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \
+        --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA \
+        --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv":8}' \

+        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
+        --enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 \
+        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --max-num-seqs 128 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 512 \
+        --enable-cumem-allocator --enable-flashinfer-autotune \
+        --load-format fastsafetensors --stream-interval 10 --language-model-only --trust-remote-code \
+        --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"compact_group_io":true,"max_load_batch_keys":2,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
+      ```
+
+      For tool calling and reasoning output, add `--reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-tool-call-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-enable-structural-tag` to both roles. `python3 -m dynamo.vllm` parses the remaining arguments as vLLM engine arguments only, so the vLLM API-server flags `--enable-auto-tool-choice` and `--tool-call-parser` are rejected there.
+
+      ### Specialized decode (low concurrency)
+
+      The c16-c32 points use the `latency_specialized` decode backend from [GB300 low-latency preset](#preset-gb300_low_latency) on the decode workers (1P3D for c16, 1P2D for c24-c32), with the Workers commands above changed as follows. The backend's requirements are listed there: V2 model runner (set in Environment), FULL decode CUDA graphs, BF16 convolution state with FP32 recurrent state, DSpark with at most 7 draft tokens, no pipeline or expert parallelism, and DCP of 1 or TP. The decode workers already meet the last two.
+
+      Both roles:
+
+      ```bash
+      --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32 --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1 --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune
+      # replacing --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 and --enable-flashinfer-autotune
+      ```
+
+      Pin `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1` on both roles. Left unset, NIXL P/D raises the DCP KV interleave to the KV block size after the specialized decode has read it, so its spec-verify causal mask uses the stale value.
+
+      Decode only:
+
+      ```bash
+      --additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}' \
+      --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true}' \
+      --max-num-seqs 12 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 64 \
+      --compilation-config "{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE\",\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\":[$(seq -s, 1 64)]}"
+      # replacing the regular decode's --attention-config (it also sets tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv),
+      # --max-num-seqs 128 and --max-cudagraph-capture-size 512
+      ```
+
+      `--max-num-seqs` is `64 // (K + 1)` with the K4 draft, so a full verify batch (12 x 5 = 60 tokens) fits the 64-token graph, and CUDA graphs are captured for every batch size up to 64. The prefill workers do not set `--additional-config`: the backend rejects the expert parallelism they use. The uncapped c48+ points keep the regular profile, so TTFT is not traded for ITL by a standing decode queue.
+
+      ### Frontend
+
+      ```bash
+      export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600 DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120
+      python3 -m dynamo.frontend --router-mode least-loaded --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 900
+      ```
+
+      Session affinity keeps each conversation on one worker so it reuses that worker's prefix cache; send the conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-Id` request header.
+
+  gb300_low_latency:
+    label: "Low latency"
+    hardware: gb300
+    strategy: multi_node_tp

+
+      The c16-c32 points use the `latency_specialized` decode backend from [GB300 low-latency preset](#preset-gb300_low_latency) on the decode workers (1P3D for c16, 1P2D for c24-c32), with the Workers commands above changed as follows. +      **Per-concurrency tuning.** The Point row renders the lane's ten cells. Every cell requests `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` with breakable CUDA graphs disabled (`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0`); because Kimi-K3 has no `torch.compile` submodule, vLLM resolves that mode to `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` at load.
